title: Valparaiso's Old Porter County Jail: 1871, and the Voices People Report

sources.what: built 1871; architect R. Rose; Italianate sheriff's house; stone jail 'connected or tied into this home'; 153 Franklin Street
sources.who: National Register of Historic Places nomination (NPS)

sources.what: contract March 8, 1871; museum moved in Sept. 17, 1974, opened May 11, 1975; left the jail March 12, 2020; reopened at 20 Indiana Ave. May 19, 2022; 'Active for 101 years as a jail'
museum in the old jail May 11, 1975 to March 12, 2020; National Register 1976
sheriffs' families lived in the residence
October ghost tours benefiting the museum (2009 on); a later tour presented by the Porter County Museum: 'Hear about haunted happenings in the old jail'
reported voices, footsteps, doors closing on their own
sources.who: Hauntings Around America; Ghost Research Society (2011 investigation)

sources.what: Indiana Ghost Trackers member describes a recorded voice
sources.who: Dig the Dunes, 'Tracking ghosts in the dunes' (2019)

beats.text: In Valparaiso, the 1871 Porter County Jail held prisoners for more than 100 years.
beats.label: VALPARAISO, INDIANA
beats.credit: History: National Register of Historic Places; Porter County Museum

beats.text: The sheriff and his family lived in the brick house attached to it.
beats.label: THE SHERIFF'S HOUSE
beats.credit: National Register of Historic Places; valpo.life

beats.text: The jail closed in 1974. The next year, it became the county museum.
beats.label: 1871 TO 1974
beats.credit: Porter County Museum; Historical Images of Porter County; Wikipedia

beats.text: October ghost tours have told of haunted happenings in the old jail.
beats.label: GHOST TOURS

beats.text: Paranormal groups say they've recorded voices, and that doors open and close on their own.
beats.label: WHAT PARANORMAL GROUPS SAY
beats.credit: Ghost Research Society (2011); Dig the Dunes; Hauntings Around America

beats.text: In 2020, the museum moved out, and in 2022 it opened in a new home nearby.
beats.label: A NEW HOME

beats.text: The old jail still stands on Franklin Street, just off the courthouse square.
beats.label: 153 S. FRANKLIN ST.
beats.credit: National Register of Historic Places; Porter County Museum; Wikipedia

beats.text: Comment your town, and it could be next.

factcheck.result: Lines 1-3, 6 supported. Tours line made less sweeping; 'footsteps' dropped (one blog only), now recorded voices and doors (Ghost Research Society, Dig the Dunes, Hauntings Around America); 'view from the sidewalk' dropped (part of the residence may be leased to a shop); mansard brick jail and domed courthouse drawings replaced (the real house has a hipped roof, the jail is stone, the courthouse has no dome). Round 2: 'seen doors' became 'say ... that doors open and close'; all supported.
